title: posit-presheaf
description: PositPresheaf: the valued presheaf that posit builds — the classical-spacetime structure. Each cell now bears a definite charge (seeded at absurd / knowledge-least ⊥); the superposition has collapsed. Posit is collapsing: the quantum → classical transition in one generator.

fiber.description: The base fiber: cell-set, base category, and entity-set — the structural scaffold predicate built.

base.description: The base category with its morphism slots.
The base category: objects and its four morphism slots (specialization, converse, subject-projection, object-projection).

entity-set.description: The entity set E for the whole presheaf.

fibers.description: One FiberAlgebra per predicate — the charged stalks, each seeded at absurd.
